title: Statistical-physics algorithms for Count Unique Games via interpolation and cluster expansion

license.name: CC BY3.0
license.adaptation_notice: Faithful editable author material from the official CCC2020 published27-page CC BY3.0 version, article13. One Count Unique Games theme: Theorems3/4 original algorithm guarantees and complete partition-function reduction7, approximation8/9, zero-free10/induction11 and full AppendixA/B proofs, random-cluster12, published cluster-convergence13/14 and complete AppendixC proofs retained. Author interpolation and cluster-expansion paths grouped as alternate methods for the same promise problem, not separately counted. Formal CCC Lemma13 and the entire formal Lemma14 proof replace the earlier different native arxiv convergence statements. The complete official31 bibliography entries retained. CUG YES promises at least(fk)^|V| highly satisfying assignments; general UG is not claimed solved and UGC implications remain conditional discussion. Exact degree/labels/f/satisfiability/error/runtime premises retained, including maximum-degree approximation bounds and regular-graph CUG bounds. Standard cited results remain original author statements without recursive reconstruction. Native arxiv1911.01504 TeX is nonexclusive and used only as a private transcription aid for corresponding published content; original archive/page/native excluded from public originals. All selected public TeX files carry only corresponding formal CCC material. Mathematical wording/printed notation retained without proof correction, including original cone C(dtheta+Delta-epsilon), Rk denominator zz-2, case1 C^-s wording, and final AppendixA wstar multiplication wording. Figure assets none. Proof locations reorganized to original AppendixA/B/C order. Five-author wrapper should use two lines to avoid clipping. Root performs compilation/database/publication.

standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Original AppendixA statements16/18 and complete author adaptations17/19 and BIGCP reduction[26,27] retained.

standard_prerequisites.name: Cluster-expansion convergence
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Formal published Lemma13[8,Lemma2.1] retained; complete author Lemma14 verification included.

core_obligations: Preserve CUG YES counting promise and NO guarantee, never replace it by usual Unique Games.
Preserve all regular/max-degree,alphabet,f,error and time conditions of original3/4/8/9.
Retain complete zero-free/induction/interpolation appendix chain, including technical maximization and small-k sections.
Retain formal published cluster convergence and full three-case polymer weight proof; group both algorithm paths once.
difficulty_reason: The authors encode a counting promise as a partition function and develop a strengthened complex-ratio induction giving a uniform zero-free region, then connect coefficient interpolation to an efficient algorithm; an independent polymer expansion yields the second parameter regime. The nonroutine induction, rational-region control and polymer weight analysis are explicit in the supplied author proof.

dedup.scope: Root complete manifest/prepared/both-line three-identity query for CCC2020.13,arxiv1911.01504 and arxiv DOI found zero same-source records. Both algorithm paths and parameter regimes grouped as one promise-problem theme. No journal/ECCC identity confirmed.
